data_source: New York City Airbnb Open Data (Kaggle: dgomonov/new-york-city-airbnb-open-data)
intended_use: Suggest a starting nightly price for a new or repriced short-term rental listing.
known_limitations: 2019 NYC snapshot only -- no photos, host-quality signal, or real-time seasonal/event-driven demand, all of which genuinely affect short-term rental pricing but aren't observable in this dataset. Should not be assumed to transfer to a different city, a later time period, or a market shaped by short-term-rental regulation changes.
